sourceProjection.basis: Visually reviewed 2026 official visitor map: two separate top-down floor diagrams, consistent parallel wall faces, no perspective convergence, and no rectification required.

review: Current official visitor map visually reviewed at full page and with indexed vector overlays. Generated wall/detail polygons were overlaid in source coordinates on both floor diagrams, including the previously omitted room partitions and individual stair treads; 64 independent wall/detail/door-gap checkpoints pass. Every printed Arabic and Roman room label was transcribed once; duplicate PDF text objects were not duplicated as places. Browser 3D rendering remains an integration-stage check.
internalNotes: 两层平面沿用官方导览图各自的原图比例，不视为经过测量配准的上下叠合。
当前导览图只标出一个展厅 VI；网页或藏品目录中的 VIa、VIb 无法在此图上分别定位。
2026 年导览图所示临时关闭属于状态信息，不用于删减建筑几何。
馆内电梯与电梯旁楼梯按两层图中对应符号及重复墙线建立连接；入口东侧楼梯未获同一梯段的明确标识，未建立跨层连接。
limitations: 包含底层与一层展区；VI 厅的 VIa、VIb 子区尚无法分别定位。
两层只展示已确认的楼梯和电梯连接；房间位置不代表当天开放状态。
